'''Mynock Coronet City''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dish that was a specialty of [[Car'ulorn's Kavsrach]]. It was a spicy dish consisting of marinated [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] strips, [[vweilu nut]]s, and [[chale]] covered in [[Lum/Legends|lum]] sauce.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', this dish is named ''Mynock Cloud City''. The correct name has yet to be established.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
